notes: Hand-assembled, not generated by `tubuild.py create`: tu_map cannot segment arm9/main, so there was no candidate id to create from. The schema follows the arm9/dFader_c entry, which took the same route.

func_0202fc40 is the class's real constructor: it writes the whole dFader_c -> dFdBrightness_c -> dFdColor_c -> dWipe_c vptr chain and the inherited field stores, i.e. the complete-object ctor with every base sub-object ctor inlined. dWipe_c stores currInterp = 0 where the siblings store 0x1000, so the inherited ctors take a `Fix12i initial = 0x1000` parameter and dWipe_c passes 0. It is folded as the real member `dWipe_c::dWipe_c()`, the symbols.txt row is renamed to _ZN7dWipe_cC1Ev, and the sole caller src/unnamed/arm9/0207/__sinit_02074f80.c is respelled to the mangled name in the same change.

func_0202ec9c is the TU's wipe-arm entry (the singleton's `this` arrives in r0); the five scene callers' file-local externs are respelled to _ZN7dWipe_c13func_0202ec9cEi. The remaining `func_0202*` helpers that take `this` are folded as members; func_0202ed48 / func_0202f2c4 / func_0202f3a4 stay free functions -- no `this` in r0 -- and keep their linker names.

_ZN7dWipe_c15SetBackwardTimeEj keeps the measured ABI seam documented in notes/scene-provenance.md: the header carries `virtual int SetBackwardTime(u32)` for the vtable spelling, while the definition is the two-parameter free-form body -- the caller passes an extra argument in r2 that the body forwards to dFdColor_c::SetBackwardTime.

#pragma opt_strength_reduction off covers the tail of the file for the two table builders: mwccarm resolves the option at end of file, so a `reset` after the pair re-enables it for the functions it precedes (measured). Every function after the pragma emits identically under either setting, which the 21/21 comparison covers.
